title: The fixed-degree polynomial Wick-Krylov compressions form a uniformly irreducible Jacobi tower

uniform_jacobi_tower.orthonormal_basis: Put phi_(j,N)=q_(j,N)(X_N)/sqrt(h_(j,N)). Multiplication by X_N has the Jacobi recurrence X_N phi_j=b_(j+1,N)phi_(j+1)+a_(j,N)phi_j+b_(j,N)phi_(j-1)
uniform_jacobi_tower.off_diagonal_bounds: K1493 gives H_j^(-1/2)<=b_(j+1,N)<=H_(j+1)^(1/2), so every fixed finite compression is uniformly irreducible in N
uniform_jacobi_tower.diagonal_bounds: Since phi_(j,N) has Wiener degree at most 4j and L2 norm one, Nelson hypercontractivity gives ||phi_j||_4<=3^(2j), hence |a_(j,N)|=|E(X_N phi_j^2)|<=3^(4j)
uniform_jacobi_tower.strict_interlacing: Let J_(d,N) be the compression to span{phi_0,...,phi_d}. It is an irreducible real Jacobi matrix, so lambda_min(J_(d,N))<lambda_min(J_(d-1,N))
uniform_jacobi_tower.uniform_fixed_degree_gap: For each fixed d>=2 the allowed coefficient arrays lie in a compact box with b_d bounded away from zero. The strict interlacing difference is continuous and positive on that compact set, so there is epsilon_d>0 independent of N with lambda_min(J_(d,N))<=lambda_min(J_(d-1,N))-epsilon_d
uniform_jacobi_tower.ceiling: The compactness proof gives one positive epsilon_d for each fixed d but no useful all-d asymptotic or summability statement
